prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Choose the pet companion that will live on your desktop and keep you company.", "Featured Pet Companion"]
1: ["Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet", "Linking your account ensures your pet's progress and custom features stay safe across sessions.", "Continue with Secure Account"]
2: ["Define Your Pet's Personality", "Select how active or quiet your desktop companion should be during work hours.", "Playful vs Calm", "Confirm Companion Traits"]
3: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop", "Your pet is active! Click and drag your companion anywhere on screen or right-click for quick actions.", "Active Pet Preview"]
4: ["Upload Photo for Custom Companion", "Preview how your pet companion will appear on screen before adoption.", "Choose Companion Image", "Pet Render Preview"]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Space", "We are setting up your pet companion's animations and desktop environment.", "Pet Waking Up"]
6: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Adopt a digital pet that lives, plays, and works alongside you right on your desktop.", "Start Adoption Journey", "Companion Greeting"]
7: ["Save Your Pet Data & Restore Anytime", "Sign in to bind your pet to your profile so your companion is never lost when re-installing or switching devices.", "Your existing pet setup and memory will instantly restore upon signing in.", "Protect My Pet Account"]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your companion is officially registered to your desktop.", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
9: ["Creating Companion Graphics", "Your companion is being rendered in high definition.", "Estimated time remaining"]
